product_overview: Karen Web is a mobile-first, privacy-focused emotional support PWA that offers a calm space for grounding, therapeutic chat, reflection, and session review. Users can move through a gentle conversation flow, revisit past sessions, and export reflection reports locally from the browser.
core_goals: Enter a calming welcome and grounding experience
Sign in or create an account with email and password
Have a therapeutic chat conversation and receive supportive responses
End a session with optional reflection capture
Review past sessions and read conversation transcripts
Generate and download a therapeutic reflection report

features.name: Welcome Splash Screen
features.description: Provides a calm first impression with a time-based greeting, breathing orb, and entry path into the app.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the ambient greeting -> Tap or click the breathing orb -> Click 'Begin when ready' -> See the grounding transition screen

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Lets users sign in or create an account with email and password before entering the experience.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Switch to the sign in or create account tab -> Fill in the email address -> Fill in the password -> Submit the form -> See the app continue into the grounding entry screen

Navigate to /auth -> Switch to create account mode -> Fill in the email address -> Fill in the password -> Fill in the password confirmation -> Submit the form -> See the app continue into the grounding entry screen
Navigate to /auth -> Enter incomplete or mismatched registration details -> Submit the form -> See a validation message

features.name: Space Transition Sequence
features.description: Creates a short calming pause before chat begins, using animated affirmations and automatic progression.
user_flows: Navigate to /enter -> Watch the orb bloom and affirmations appear -> Observe the automatic transition into chat

features.name: Therapeutic Chat Interaction
features.description: Supports an ongoing emotional support conversation with message entry, assistant responses, timestamps, settings, and session-ending controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /chat -> Type an emotional reflection or message -> Submit the message -> Observe a typing indicator -> See the assistant response appear
Navigate to /chat -> Send a message -> Tap the assistant message -> See its timestamp reveal
Navigate to /chat -> Open the settings drawer -> Browse session options or app information -> Close the drawer
Navigate to /chat -> Use the session end control -> Proceed to the session ending flow

features.name: Crisis Support Overlay
features.description: Shows immediate support resources when a crisis or self-harm statement is detected during chat.
user_flows: Navigate to /chat -> Send a message indicating self-harm or crisis -> See the crisis support overlay appear with hotline resources -> Dismiss the overlay to return to chat

features.name: End Session Flow
features.description: Guides the user through a two-step wrap-up, with the option to continue chatting, save a reflection, or finish the session.
user_flows: Navigate to /end -> Choose to stay a little longer -> Return to chat
Navigate to /end -> Choose to end for now -> Proceed to the reflection prompt -> Choose to save the reflection -> See the reflection report open
Navigate to /end -> Choose to end for now -> Proceed to the reflection prompt -> Choose not to save a reflection -> See the completion screen

features.name: Session Completion Screen
features.description: Provides a gentle farewell and routes the user back to other parts of the app from the completed session state.
user_flows: Navigate to /complete -> View the time-based farewell message -> Use the bottom navigation to return to chat, history, or the grounding flow

features.name: Session History and Journal
features.description: Lets users browse prior sessions and open a read-only transcript replay for any saved session.
user_flows: Navigate to /history -> Browse past session cards and emotional indicators -> Open a session card -> View the full transcript replay
Navigate to /history -> Open a session detail -> View the reflection area -> Read the saved reflection or generate one if available

features.name: Therapeutic Reflection Report
features.description: Presents a structured six-part reflection summary and allows the user to download it as a PDF from the browser.
user_flows: Navigate to /report -> Review the six-section reflection summary -> Click 'Download PDF' -> Save the formatted report locally
Navigate to /report -> Review the report summary -> Click 'Return to Karen' -> Go back to the home experience

routes.description: Welcome and splash screen with ambient greeting and breathing orb
Authentication screen with Sign In and Create Account tabs
Grounding space transition with breathing orb and calming affirmations
Real-time therapeutic chat session with emotion detection, settings drawer, and crisis overlay
Two-step session ending confirmation and reflection prompt
Session complete screen with warm orb, time-contextual farewell, and navigation
Past sessions history list with emotion arcs and reflection indicators
Historical session transcript replay and on-demand reflection viewer
Therapeutic reflection report summary and client-side PDF export
